verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs describe reserved instances: you pre-pay for GPU time to get discounts of up to 50%, and you can convert any on-demand instance to reserved at any time. That directly delivers locked-in discounts for sustained capacity. The documentation is thin beyond that headline. Missing for 10: details on commitment terms and durations, how the discount tiers are structured, CLI/API support for buying reservations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity

citations.quote: Reserved instances allow you to get significant discounts (up to 50%) by pre-paying for GPU time. You can convert any on-demand instance to a reserved instance at any time.
You can convert an on-demand instance into a reserved instance with a lower hourly rate by pre-paying.
